newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks mixed at opening, Dow trace lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks mixed at opening, Dow trace lower.

text.p: The Dow Industrials moved slightly lower at the opening of trading on Friday, pulling back from its record close.
The Dow industrials was off five points at 6,200. The NASDAQ Index was up 0.22 of a point to 1,254.36, while the S&P Index was off about 0.5 at 727.
The long bond was off 2/32 to yield 6.49 percent.
